summary: One-time and recurring checkout preparation must validate card, boleto, and PIX against live store capabilities before a browser handoff.
reason: Recurring baskets may silently reuse a saved card, while one-time purchases require an explicit payment choice; omitting that distinction leaves an agent unable to explain or complete the safe handoff. Payment secrets and final confirmation remain in Shopper's CSRF-protected browser flow.
validated_outcome: The CLI lists live method availability, rejects disabled PIX, validates cart readiness, and prepares card or boleto checkout in the default browser or an explicitly selected authenticated Brave session without handling credentials or submitting an order.
